title: Excel Sheet Column Title
summary: Encode a spreadsheet column number using uppercase letters.

contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned str.

statement: Encode a spreadsheet column number using uppercase letters. The first 26 columns are A through Z, then AA, AB, and so on. Return the label for the given one-based number.

examples.explanation: The last one-letter column is Z.
The next column starts the two-letter labels.
The largest allowed column has seven letters.

hints: Conceptual: Unlike ordinary positional digits, this alphabet has no zero symbol.
Directional: Adjust the current number by one before extracting a digit.
Implementation: Repeatedly decrement, use the remainder modulo 26 for the next letter from the right, then divide by 26 and reverse the collected letters.
complexityAnalysis: O(log₍₂₆₎ n) time and O(log₍₂₆₎ n) result storage.
